run_class_finetuning_train: run BEiT fine-tuning training on image classification dataset with configurable model and optimizer
run_class_finetuning_evaluate: evaluate a fine-tuned BEiT model on validation dataset and report accuracy metrics
run_class_finetuning_resume: resume BEiT fine-tuning training from a saved checkpoint with optimizer and EMA state
run_class_finetuning_finetune: fine-tune a pretrained BEiT vision transformer model from checkpoint with position embedding interpolation
run_class_finetuning_config: configure BEiT fine-tuning arguments including batch size, learning rate, dropout, and mixup augmentation
